excerpt_en: Agent software has no compiler, no contracts, nothing that structurally rejects wrong-but-plausible behavior. The only specification that actually executes is the eval suite — and whatever it measures is what the system optimizes to become.
excerpt_zh: 智能体软件没有编译器、没有契约，没有任何东西在结构上拒绝「错误但看起来合理」的行为。唯一会被执行的规格，是评测集——它度量什么，系统就被优化成什么。

excerpt_en: When an agent breaks in production, the incident gets filed against the model — the loudest, least debuggable component, and the perfect scapegoat. But most agent incidents are born in the layers around the model: the harness, the tools, the world. Deterministic failure is never model failure.
excerpt_zh: 当智能体在生产环境中出问题时，事故单总被记在模型头上——最显眼、最难调试的组件，完美的替罪羊。但大多数智能体事故，其实源于模型周围的层：harness、工具、世界。一个每次都复现的失败，绝不是模型的失败。

title_zh: 你的智能体，终会被中断
excerpt_en: Every long-running agent will be interrupted — by a deploy, a crash, a rate limit. The uninterrupted run is a fantasy. Separate the run from the process, represent the run as an append-only event log where state is derived rather than stored, and close the side-effect window with idempotency keys — or replay your failures forever.
excerpt_zh: 每一个长时运行的智能体都会被中断——被部署、崩溃或限流。「不被中断的运行」是幻想。把运行从进程中分离出来，用只追加的事件日志表示运行、让状态被推导而非被存储，并用幂等键关闭副作用窗口——否则你会永远重放自己的失败。

title_zh: 你的智能体，请示得太频繁了
excerpt_en: An agent that asks before every action is not safe — it is a subscription to interruption. Human attention is a budget that depletes, not a service that scales. Approve policies instead of instances, route the reversible to rules and only the irreversible to humans, and engineer silence to mean the safe branch.
excerpt_zh: 一个在每个动作之前都要请示的智能体，并不安全——它是一份「打断订阅」。人的注意力是一个会耗尽的预算，不是一个能扩容的服务。批准策略而非实例，让可逆的动作走规则、只让不可逆的动作走向人，并让沉默在工程上意味着安全的分支。

title_en: Your Agent Believes Everything It Reads
title_zh: 你的智能体，相信它读到的一切
excerpt_en: Every tool result your agent fetches is untrusted input from a foreign author, yet it enters the same token stream as your system prompt — with the same authority. Tool-result injection is not a prompt bug to patch with one more warning line. It is an architecture problem: make belief cheap, action expensive, and never let the model be the only check between the internet and the write path.
excerpt_zh: 智能体抓取的每一个工具结果，都是一个来自陌生作者的不受信输入，却和你的系统 prompt 进入同一股 token 流——带着同样的权威。工具结果注入，不是一个多加一行警告就能补掉的 prompt bug。它是一个架构问题：让相信便宜，让行动昂贵，绝不让模型成为互联网与写入路径之间唯一的检查。

title_en: The Cache Is Not an Optimization
excerpt_en: Every agent loop re-sends nearly the same giant context on every call. Teams treat prompt caching as a nice-to-have optimization. It is not. Cache locality is the architecture — the single largest lever over cost, latency, and consistency, and a discipline that shapes how the entire prompt is built.
excerpt_zh: 智能体的循环，每次都重发几乎一模一样的巨大上下文。团队们把 prompt 缓存当作一个「锦上添花」的优化。它不是。缓存局部性，就是架构本身——对成本、延迟和一致性最大的那根杠杆，一门塑造整个 prompt 如何构建的纪律。

title_en: The Context Is Not the Prompt
excerpt_en: Teams obsess over the prompt — the static string they author. But the prompt is a fraction of what the model sees at decision time. The real artifact is the context: an assembled, dynamic bundle of tool results, retrieved documents, history, and injected state. Context engineering — not prompt engineering — is where agent behavior is actually born.
excerpt_zh: 团队们痴迷于提示词——那个他们亲手写的静态字符串。但提示词只是模型在决策时所见之物的一小部分。真正的产物，是上下文。上下文工程，而非提示词工程，才是智能体行为真正诞生的地方。

title_en: The Agent Doesn't Know When to Stop
title_zh: 智能体，不知道何时该停下
excerpt_en: Every agent loop ends, but most end for the wrong reason. The model has no concept of done — only of what token comes next. Stopping is a policy decision, and the teams that leave it to the model get agents that terminate prematurely, loop forever, or declare victory over wrong work. Termination is an engineering problem, not an emergent property of intelligence.
excerpt_zh: 每一个智能体的循环都会结束，但大多数，因为错误的原因而结束。模型没有「完成」的概念——它只有「下一个 token」的概念。停下，是一条策略；把它交给模型的团队，得到的是过早终止、永不终止、或对着错误工作宣布胜利的智能体。终止，是一个工程问题，不是智能的涌现属性。

title_en: Your Agent Will Be Run Twice
title_zh: 你的智能体，会被运行两次
excerpt_en: Every agent action will be executed more than once — a retry, a resume, a replay, a duplicate request. The architecture that assumes exactly-once execution is the architecture that double-charges customers and writes conflicting records. Idempotency keys and checkpointing are not optimizations; they are the load-bearing wall of any agent that touches the real world.
excerpt_zh: 每一个智能体的动作，都会被执行不止一次——一次重试、一次恢复、一次重放、一次重复请求。假设「恰好执行一次」的架构，就是那个会给客户扣两次款、写下冲突记录的架构。幂等键和检查点，不是优化；它们是任何触碰真实世界的智能体的承重墙。

excerpt_en: An agent ships a confident answer. The team asks the model to check it. The model says yes. The answer was wrong. Self-grading measures confidence, not correctness — and the two are almost uncorrelated. Verification must come from outside the generator: deterministic checks, ground-truth lookups, execution, and only then an independent model, never the one that wrote the answer.
excerpt_zh: 一个智能体交付了一份自信的答案。团队让模型检查它。模型说是的。答案是错的。自我打分，测的是置信度，不是正确性——而两者几乎不相关。验证必须来自生成器之外：确定性检查、地面真相查询、执行，然后才是独立的模型——永远不是写下答案的那个。

excerpt_en: Every production agent eventually hits the moment its primary path fails — the model is overloaded, the tool times out, retrieval returns garbage. Most teams build a single chain that must never break, and watch it break catastrophically. The teams that ship reliable agents build a ladder: explicit degradation steps at every node, descending from the ideal to the merely acceptable, never into the catastrophic.
excerpt_zh: 每一个生产环境的智能体，终会撞上它主路径失败的那一刻。大多数团队构建的是一条绝不能断的单链，然后眼睁睁看着它灾难性地断掉。那些发布可靠智能体的团队，造的是一架阶梯：在每个节点上，显式的降级步骤，从理想下降到勉强可接受，绝不跌入灾难。

title_en: Two Agents Are Slower Than One
title_zh: 两个智能体，比一个还慢
excerpt_en: A team splits its agent into a planner, a coder, and a reviewer, expecting specialization to bring gains. It brings a tax instead. Every handoff duplicates context, serializes state lossily, and adds a round trip where nothing useful happens. One agent with better tools and a smarter loop beats the fleet more often than the fleet beats it.
excerpt_zh: 一个团队把它的智能体拆成规划者、编码者和审查者，期望分工带来收益。结果带来的是一笔税。每一次交接都复制上下文、有损地序列化状态、并增加一个什么有用的事都不发生的往返。一个配着更好工具和更聪明循环的智能体，赢过舰队的次数，比舰队赢过它的次数更多。

title_zh: 脚手架比模型活得更久
excerpt_en: Every six months a new model lands and the team throws out its agent and starts over. The team that wins is not the one on the newest model — it is the one whose harness survives the swap. The control loop, the tool contracts, the evals, the replay infrastructure are the only parts of an agent that compound. The model is rented. The harness is owned.
excerpt_zh: 每隔半年，一个新模型落地，团队就把整个智能体推倒重来。赢的团队，不是用着最新模型的那个，而是那个脚手架能挺过模型替换的团队。控制循环、工具契约、评估套件、复现基础设施，是智能体里唯一会复利增长的部分。模型是租来的。脚手架，是自己拥有的。

excerpt_en: Every agent team chases a better model — bigger, faster, cheaper per token. But the highest-leverage optimization in agent engineering is not a better model. It is not calling the model at all. A model call is the most expensive, slowest, least consistent operation an agent does, and most teams treat it as the default. The teams that win treat it as the last resort.
excerpt_zh: 每个智能体团队都在追逐更好的模型——更强、更快、每个 token 更便宜。但智能体工程里杠杆最大的优化，不是更好的模型，而是根本不调用模型。模型调用是智能体所做的一切里最贵、最慢、最不一致的操作，而大多数团队把它当作默认选项。赢的团队，把它当作最后的手段。

title_en: The Plan Is Not the Work
excerpt_en: An agent writes a plan, and the team watches it think. The plan looks brilliant — five crisp steps, each reasonable. Then execution begins, and the plan starts dying on contact with reality. The plan was always the cheap part: the first thing the model produces, before it has touched a tool or been surprised. Planning feels like intelligence. Execution is where intelligence is actually tested.
excerpt_zh: 智能体写下了一份计划，团队凑近屏幕看。计划很漂亮——五个利落的步骤。然后执行开始，计划在接触现实的瞬间开始死去。计划从来是最廉价的部分：模型产出的第一样东西，在它碰过任何工具或被惊到之前。计划看起来像智能。执行，才是智能真正被检验的地方。

excerpt_en: A tool call fails. The team blames the model, swaps in a stronger one, and it fails differently. The bug was never the model — it was the tool definition, which read like an invitation to do the wrong thing. Every tool name, description, and schema is a prompt the model follows literally.
excerpt_zh: 一次工具调用失败了。团队指责模型，换上更强的模型，失败方式不同了，但依然失败。问题从来不在模型——而在那个工具定义，它读起来像是在邀请模型做错事。每一个工具名、描述、schema，都是模型字面遵循的提示词。

excerpt_en: Every token an agent generates is billed. Teams know their accuracy and latency — but most cannot answer what one completed task costs. The stateless tax, the retry cascade, and the gap between benchmark cost and production cost decide whether an agent is a product or a science project.
excerpt_zh: 智能体生成的每一个 token，都是要计费的。团队知道自己的准确率和延迟，但大多数回答不了：完成一个任务到底要花多少钱？无状态税、重试级联、以及基准成本与生产成本之间的鸿沟，决定了智能体是产品，还是一个科学实验。

title_zh: 每个智能体之下，都有一张图
excerpt_en: Every agent system has a topology — a directed graph of nodes and edges. Most teams never draw it. They write a loop, bolt on conditionals, and discover the graph only when it breaks: the infinite retry, the dead-end branch, the tool called nine times. The model is just a node. The graph is the system.
excerpt_zh: 每一个智能体系统，都有一个拓扑——一张由节点和边构成的有向图。大多数团队从不画它。他们写一个循环，钉上几个条件判断，然后只在它崩掉时才看见这张图：无限重试、死胡同分支、同一个工具被调九次。模型只是节点。图才是系统。

title_en: You Can't Debug What You Can't Replay
title_zh: 你无法调试，无法复现的东西
excerpt_en: For seventy years, a bug meant a stack trace — a reproducible arrow pointing at the failing line. An agent has no stack trace. Every run is a unique path through a probabilistic space, gone the instant the response returns. A bug report that says the agent was wrong is not a bug report. It is a ghost story.
excerpt_zh: 七十年来，一个 bug 意味着一条堆栈追踪——一支可复现的箭头，精确指向出错的那一行。一个智能体没有堆栈追踪。每一次运行，都是穿越概率空间的一条独一无二的路径，在响应返回的那一刻就消失了。一个写着「智能体错了」的 bug 报告，不是 bug 报告。它是一个鬼故事。

excerpt_en: A slow feature used to be an inconvenience. An agent that takes thirty seconds to answer is not slow — it is broken. The wait is where trust dies, where the loop burns money, where a timeout kills the run mid-thought.
excerpt_zh: 一个慢的功能，过去只是不方便。一个要花三十秒才回答的智能体，不是慢——它是坏的。等待，是信任死去的地方，是循环烧钱的地方，是一个超时中途掐断思考的地方。

title_zh: 你的智能体，没有编译器
excerpt_en: For seventy years, software shipped with a safety net — the compiler, the type checker, the test suite. An AI agent has none of this. It runs, produces fluent output, and fails in ways that look exactly like success. The eval suite is the only gate standing between plausible and correct.
excerpt_zh: 七十年来，软件发布时都带着安全网——编译器、类型检查、测试套件。一个 AI 智能体，这些都没有。它运行，产出流畅的输出，以一种看起来和成功一模一样的方式失败。评估套件，是「看起来对」和「真的对」之间唯一的闸门。

title_en: The Context Window Is Not Memory
title_zh: 上下文窗口，不等于记忆
excerpt_en: Every model release ships with a bigger context window, and every time teams treat it as a memory upgrade. It is not. The window is a scratchpad. Memory is something you engineer, retrieve, and test.
excerpt_zh: 每次模型发布，上下文窗口都更大；每次，团队都把它当成记忆升级。它不是。窗口是草稿纸。记忆是需要你亲手工程、亲手检索、亲手测试的东西。

title_en: The Model Is the Engine, Not the Car
excerpt_en: Teams keep asking which model is best. Wrong question. The model is an engine, and engines don't drive themselves. The harness is the car.
excerpt_zh: 所有人都在问「哪个模型最强」。问错了。模型是引擎，而引擎不会自己跑起来。真正上路的是脚手架——那辆车。

title_zh: 意大利面与 API 账单
excerpt_en: Most multi-agent systems aren't architectures. They're one big prompt chopped into pieces, each piece burning money. The fix is older than AI itself.
excerpt_zh: 大部分「多智能体系统」根本不是架构。只是一个 prompt 被切成几块，每块都在烧钱。解法比 AI 本身还老。

title_en: The Loop Is the New Function
excerpt_en: For 70 years the function was the atom of software. Now it's the loop. What changes when code stops running once and starts running forever?
excerpt_zh: 七十年来，函数是软件的原子——输入进去，输出出来，完事。然后 AI 智能体出现了，它不停止。
